hcata_paper.title: Human Cell Aging Transcriptome Atlas (HCATA): a single-cell atlas of age-associated transcriptomic alterations across human tissues

hcata_public_web_client.used_for: Public API route, integer Ensembl conversion, adjusted-p display scale and decade-change conversion

muscle_source_study.title: Single nuclei profiling identifies cell specific markers of skeletal muscle aging, frailty, and senescence

hcata_statistical_method: Paper describes NEBULA negative-binomial mixed models with age as a continuous variable and sex as a covariate. Cohort-specific sex/covariate inputs cannot be verified from portal metadata.
reference_expression_scale: Paper describes Seurat library-size normalization to 10000 followed by natural-log transform; exported age effects are described as annual Log2FC. No TPM ground truth is provided here.
